research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: LuxCreo Inc. is researching systems and methods for orthodontic appliance production, including determining baseline thickness for orthodontic appliances, as described in 'Systems and methods for orthodontic appliance production.' The company is also developing additive manufacturing devices and methods, such as those using light sources to cure photocurable resins, and composite release films for separating cured layers during 3D printing. These efforts focus on dental aligner manufacturing and related additive technologies.

overview_description.description: Launched in 2017, LuxCreo Inc. is at the forefront of dental innovation with the first full-stack, FDA Class II 510(k) cleared additive manufacturing platform. Specializing in 3D printed dental solutions, LuxCreo boosts productivity by 3-10 times in dental clinics and laboratories, allowing for the efficient same-day creation of aligners, retainers, night guards, and splints. This transformational approach ensures rapid delivery, elevating patient care with unmatched precision, speed, and hygiene.

product.name: 4D Aligner™
product.description: A direct-printed clear dental aligner using ActiveMemory™ polymer for precise tooth movement without attachments, enabling faster, more comfortable orthodontic treatment.

product.name: 4D Bright™ Aligner
product.description: A clear dental aligner that combines tooth straightening with whitening, featuring a translucent white shade and ActiveMemory™ polymer for daily rejuvenation.

product.name: EMA 3D™ Same-Day Sleep Apnea Solutions
product.description: 3D-printed custom dental devices for sleep apnea treatment, produced same-day to improve patient care and reduce wait times.

product.name: LuxCreo Smart Factory 3D Printing Solutions
product.description: Industrial-grade 3D printing systems and connected smart factory services for scalable production of personalized medical and dental devices.

product.name: iLux Pro Dental System
product.description: A desktop 3D printing system for in-clinic production of dental appliances, enabling same-day design, printing, and delivery.

product.name: LuxCreo Materials
product.description: A range of medical-grade 3D printing resins optimized for producing durable, precise, and biocompatible medical and dental devices.
